topic: Breath series 2b: Coherence breathing, practice-only version (sun on an even wave, mountains, off grid)
build_note: Practice-only coherence breathing (5 in, 5 out, six breaths). Sun rides a scrolling even wave; one mountain ridge rises per finished breath; code in /home/claude/coh/reel. David voice, 409 credits. Guitar bed, beat-matched loop. References copied from the 7 Nov coherence Reel caption. Matt approved and asked to schedule (18 Nov 2026).
caption:
Do you have a minute? Six even breaths of coherence breathing, paced for you.

Breathe in for five seconds, then out for five, smoothly and not too big, with no holds. That's about six breaths a minute.

If you feel light-headed, go back to your usual breathing.

The practice-only version of our coherence breathing Reel. The full version, with the research behind it, is on our profile @equal_psychology.

Save this for another time.
